# Rainbow Polypack

> Precision PET Preform Manufacturers in Chhatral and Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Specializing in high-performance CTC 29/21mm neck finish preforms with 100% Hot Runner Mould technology.

## Documentation & Pages

- [Home](https://www.rainbowpolypack.com/): Homepage featuring 3D mould visualizer, technical preform catalog, and agility benchmarks.
- [About Us](https://www.rainbowpolypack.com/about): Corporate overview, management experience, zero-defect manufacturing, and plant facility details in Chhatral GIDC, Gujarat.
- [Sustainability](https://www.rainbowpolypack.com/sustainability): Circular economy packaging, EPR regulatory compliance, and food-grade rPET on-demand processing.
- [Technical Quote & E-Brochure](https://www.rainbowpolypack.com/brochure): RFQ inquiry form, TDS specification request, and downloadable technical catalogue.

## Products

- [CTC 29/21mm - 15g Preform](https://www.rainbowpolypack.com/): 15 gram preform engineered for 250ml to 500ml edible oils, sauces, vinegar, and condiment containers.
- [CTC 29/21mm - 24g Preform](https://www.rainbowpolypack.com/): 24 gram preform engineered for 1000ml (1 Litre) edible oils and liquid packaging.
- [CTC 29/21mm - 26g Preform](https://www.rainbowpolypack.com/): 26 gram heavy-duty preform engineered for 1000ml premium edible oils and high-stress packaging.
